properties.name: An unknown-field refusal names the nearest served parameter first; the stale-client line is a possibility offered second
properties.rationale: flo2 F1, root-caused 2026-09-18: five of six rejected names never existed in any release; the refusal's leading sentence produced a wrong field report. The server cannot know its history; it can name the nearest served name.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: service.rs stale_client_hint parses serde's unknown-field message, picks the closest legal name by edit distance with a shared-prefix/suffix tie-break (node_id → id, parent_id → project_id, authored_at → acted_at), and leads with it; the version/staleness sentence follows as 'if nothing listed is what you meant'. Test: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/an_unknown_field_refusal_names_the_nearest_parameter.rs (3).
